modules.name: Autonomy Control Plane
modules.target: policy, shadow/canary/general, audit, exceptions

modules.name: TrendOS Live Connector
modules.target: read/write contracts + events without duplicating truth

modules.name: AI Orchestrator
modules.target: tool-using multi-agent orchestration under autonomy policy

modules.name: Operator Task D1 Authority
modules.target: D1 claim/start/complete/events retaining V2 public contract

modules.name: Production Scheduler + Capacity/Deadline Engine
modules.target: predict completion time, machine/operator loading, deadline promises, queue rebalance

modules.name: Employee AI Supervisor + Andon Resolver
modules.target: system-assigned next task, coaching, blocker auto-resolution, structured D1 Andon

modules.name: Design Recipe Engine
modules.target: approved product recipes, asset lineage, must_keep/must_avoid, exact dimensions/text

modules.name: AI Preflight
modules.target: size/aspect/DPI/text/stroke/cut/asset completeness and identity-preservation checks

modules.name: QC Vision
modules.target: compare produced photo/camera evidence to expected design and create rework task

modules.name: Material / Inventory Agent
modules.target: D1 material ledger, custody, consumption, waste, reconciliation, all departments

modules.name: Purchasing Agent
modules.target: shortage forecasting, purchase proposals, supplier/range policies

modules.name: Profitability Brain
modules.target: true contribution per order/product/customer including rework/time/waste

modules.name: Customer/Employee Intelligence
modules.target: evidence-first profiles, coaching signals, customer value/friction, reviewed facts

modules.name: Customer/Whats Agent
modules.target: AI intake, context, safe auto reply, escalation

modules.name: Machine Agent + Local Production Bridge
modules.target: general machine capability/session/telemetry model, D1 authority, local execution bridge, maintenance signals

modules.name: SOP + Training Agent
modules.target: generate/update SOPs, contextual worker guidance, skill matrix and training

modules.name: Self-Healing / Degraded Mode
modules.target: provider fallback, queue fallback, degraded mode, automatic recovery and escalation

modules.name: Control Tower + Owner Exception Console
modules.target: shop health, deadlines, exceptions, inventory/security/finance thresholds; no routine queue management

modules.name: Owner Simulation / Absence Test
modules.target: 7-day and later 14-day owner-silent rehearsal, every owner intervention becomes gap/bug/policy item

modules.name: EasyStore Finance Adapter
modules.target: finance remains separate authority; controlled read/post/reconcile contracts only

modules.name: Lead Hunter / Growth
modules.target: growth after autonomous operations stabilizes

modules.name: Operational Reality Snapshot
modules.target: one normalized evidence snapshot for active/closed/exception/fly-print work; deterministic next-task ranking; future D1 live connector input

modules.name: Native Order Schedule Metadata
modules.target: persist deterministic expected-delivery metadata for native Orders; future writes must maintain the schedule at order creation/update time

modules.name: Readiness Evidence Layer
modules.target: evidence-bound DESIGN/MATERIAL/MACHINE readiness with TTL, provenance, fail-closed UNKNOWN semantics

modules.name: Shadow Decision Observer
modules.target: persist shadow decisions and recommended decisions over time without business writes

key_rule: No new standalone project/repo per module. All autonomous-printshop module code belongs under autonomous-printshop/ unless it must remain an upstream runtime integration file.
